name: Stepper
label: Stepper
description: Step-by-step progress indicator for wizards and multi-stage flows.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered list of steps in the flow

props.name: activeStep
props.description:
Index of the active step. Steps before it render as complete (check
icon), steps after it as upcoming (step number). Pass `steps.length`
to mark the whole flow complete.

props.name: onStepClick
props.description:
Callback with the clicked step's index. When provided, completed steps
and the active step become buttons so the reader can revisit an earlier
stage; upcoming steps stay non-interactive either way.

props.name: completeLabel
props.description:
Status read after a completed step's label. The check mark that draws the
state is decorative, so this visually hidden text is what tells a screen
reader a done step from an upcoming one. Defaults to "Completed".

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the step numbers is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.
